name: Tripwire
tagline: Agents that make business decisions, record exactly which data each one depends on, and reopen only the affected decisions when that data changes.

run.docker: docker build -t tripwire . && docker run -p 8000:8000 -e SAMPLE_MODE=true tripwire
run.sample_mode: SAMPLE_MODE=true runs offline with bundled data and rule-based model fallbacks; no keys needed

agents.name: Analyst
agents.role: runs queries, computes metrics, summarises findings

agents.name: Evidence Critic
agents.role: checks findings against query hashes, rejects stale memory, reviews summary and decision

agents.name: Memory Keeper
agents.role: recalls, withholds stale and records claims with lineage

agents.name: Decider
agents.role: keep / dual_source / exit with confidence and tripwires

zetaris.used_for: all source reads via Zetaris SQL (REST); approved decisions appended to a Parquet ledger through Zetaris RUN EXPORT and read back with Zetaris SQL

meterless.used_for: claim memory with row-level lineage (derivedFrom), recall, supersession and audit ledger
meterless.notes: reference engine vendored (Apache-2.0, upstream commit 1742dec); hash embedder, not semantic

cursor.used_for: development environment; project rules and Cursor CLI-written tests
